eyebrow: A virtual disk is just a file
code:
Host filesystem:  C:\VMs\Server1.vhdx   (240 GB file)
Guest sees:       C:\  (a 200 GB NTFS drive)
caption: VMware uses VMDK; Hyper-V uses VHD/VHDX. One host file, one guest drive.

steps.label: Thick
steps.sub: full size reserved on the host disk up front

steps.label: Thin
